module: Records drift statistics in gameplay_statistic (drift/... keys) and unlocks drift achievements. Listens to the drift end, score, spinout and crash hooks; contains no detection logic.
notes: Keys written: drift/rightDrifts, drift/leftDrifts, drift/maxDriftDistance.length, drift/maxDriftTime.time, drift/maxChainedDrifts, drift/totalScore, drift/maxDriftScore, drift/spinOuts, drift/crashes.
Achievements: DRIFT_SINGLE if a single drift earns >= 20000 points; DRIFT_TOTAL if drift/totalScore reaches 1,000,000 (only if gameplay_achievement is loaded).
Maxima are only updated if the new value strictly exceeds the old one (setNewMaxStat).

onDriftCompleted.desc: Hook: at the end of a drift chain, adds the right/left drifts and updates the records for distance, duration and number of chained drifts. Does nothing without data.chainDriftData.

data.desc: Contains chainDriftData {rightDrifts, leftDrifts, totalDriftDistance, totalDriftTime, chainedDrifts}.

onDriftCompletedScored.desc: Hook: adds the earned score to the total, updates the score record and triggers the DRIFT_SINGLE and DRIFT_TOTAL achievements.

data.desc: Contains addedScore (number, points added by this drift).
